rayquaza_encounter.description: The ancient ruler of the ozone layer and master of the Hoenn Weather Trio.
rayquaza_encounter.generalInstructions: In Pokémon Emerald, summon Rayquaza to Sootopolis City to pacify Kyogre and Groudon. After defeating the Elite Four, return to Route 131 with a Mach Bike to climb the crumbling floors of Sky Pillar. Rayquaza awaits at Lv. 70. Recommended: Sleep + False Swipe + Ultra/Timer Ball.

Ruby.instructions: Surf east from Pacifidlog Town along Route 131 to the hidden ocean opening leading to the Sky Pillar. In Emerald, awaken Rayquaza during the Sootopolis drought/storm cutscene, then return post-game with the Mach Bike to cross cracked tiles and capture Rayquaza on the summit at Lv. 70.
Ruby.prerequisites: Mach Bike and Surf (Post-game or during main story in Emerald)

Sapphire.location: Sky Pillar (Route 131)
Sapphire.instructions: Surf east from Pacifidlog Town along Route 131 to the hidden ocean opening leading to the Sky Pillar. In Emerald, awaken Rayquaza during the Sootopolis drought/storm cutscene, then return post-game with the Mach Bike to cross cracked tiles and capture Rayquaza on the summit at Lv. 70.
Sapphire.prerequisites: Mach Bike and Surf (Post-game or during main story in Emerald)

Emerald.instructions: Surf east from Pacifidlog Town along Route 131 to the hidden ocean opening leading to the Sky Pillar. In Emerald, awaken Rayquaza during the Sootopolis drought/storm cutscene, then return post-game with the Mach Bike to cross cracked tiles and capture Rayquaza on the summit at Lv. 70.
Emerald.prerequisites: Mach Bike and Surf (Post-game or during main story in Emerald)

celebi_ilex_shrine.name: Celebi Mythical Event (Ilex Forest GS Ball Shrine)
celebi_ilex_shrine.description: Use the sacred GS Ball at the wooden forest shrine deep within Ilex Forest to awaken the Mythical Time Travel Pokémon Celebi (Lv. 30).

Crystal.location: Ilex Forest Shrine
Crystal.instructions: Obtain the GS Ball from the Goldenrod Pokémon Center (or Virtual Console distribution). Take the ball to Kurt in Azalea Town to inspect. After 24 hours, Kurt returns the trembling GS Ball. Place it into the wooden shrine in Ilex Forest to battle Celebi (Lv. 30).
Crystal.prerequisites: GS Ball key item

Gold.location: Ilex Forest Shrine
Gold.instructions: In Generation 2 lore, Celebi protects Ilex Forest and resides within the sacred shrine.
Gold.prerequisites: None

Silver.location: Ilex Forest Shrine
Silver.instructions: In Generation 2 lore, Celebi protects Ilex Forest and resides within the sacred shrine.
Silver.prerequisites: None

HeartGold.instructions: Take an event-distributed fateful encounter Celebi to the Ilex Forest Shrine. Your partner and Lyra/Ethan will be swept back in time to witness Giovanni abandoning Silver and battle Giovanni at Tohjo Falls.

SoulSilver.location: Ilex Forest Shrine
SoulSilver.instructions: Take an event-distributed fateful encounter Celebi to the Ilex Forest Shrine. Your partner and Lyra/Ethan will be swept back in time to witness Giovanni abandoning Silver and battle Giovanni at Tohjo Falls.
SoulSilver.prerequisites: Event Celebi in party

jirachi_wishmaker.name: Jirachi Mythical Encounter (Mossdeep White Rock)
jirachi_wishmaker.description: The Mythical Wishmaker Pokémon Jirachi, slumbering in stasis near the mystical White Rock outside the Mossdeep Space Center.

Ruby.instructions: Transfer Jirachi from the Pokémon Colosseum Bonus Disc or Pokémon Channel. In Hoenn lore, Jirachi awakens once every thousand years by the mysterious White Rock outside Mossdeep Space Center.
Ruby.prerequisites: Colosseum Bonus Disc transfer or Mystery Event

Sapphire.location: Mossdeep Space Center (White Rock)
Sapphire.instructions: Transfer Jirachi from the Pokémon Colosseum Bonus Disc or Pokémon Channel. In Hoenn lore, Jirachi awakens once every thousand years by the mysterious White Rock outside Mossdeep Space Center.
Sapphire.prerequisites: Colosseum Bonus Disc transfer or Mystery Event

Emerald.instructions: Transfer Jirachi or receive via Nintendo event distribution. Commemorate wishes at the mysterious White Rock outside Mossdeep Space Center where cosmic energy converges.

kanto_birds.name: Legendary Birds (Articuno, Zapdos, Moltres)
kanto_birds.description: The legendary winged mirage trio of Kanto: Articuno in Seafoam Islands B4F, Zapdos in the abandoned Power Plant, and Moltres in Victory Road (RGBY) or Mt. Ember (FRLG).

Red.location: Seafoam Islands / Power Plant / Victory Road
Red.instructions:
• Articuno (Lv. 50): Deepest floor of Seafoam Islands B4F. Requires Strength and Surf.
• Zapdos (Lv. 50): Abandoned Power Plant off Route 10. Surf south from Route 9.
• Moltres (Lv. 50): Victory Road 2F before Indigo Plateau.
Red.prerequisites: HM03 Surf and HM04 Strength

Blue.location: Seafoam Islands / Power Plant / Victory Road
Blue.instructions:
• Articuno (Lv. 50): Deepest floor of Seafoam Islands B4F. Requires Strength and Surf.
• Zapdos (Lv. 50): Abandoned Power Plant off Route 10. Surf south from Route 9.
• Moltres (Lv. 50): Victory Road 2F before Indigo Plateau.
Blue.prerequisites: HM03 Surf and HM04 Strength

Yellow.location: Seafoam Islands / Power Plant / Victory Road
Yellow.instructions:
• Articuno (Lv. 50): Deepest floor of Seafoam Islands B4F. Requires Strength and Surf.
• Zapdos (Lv. 50): Abandoned Power Plant off Route 10. Surf south from Route 9.
• Moltres (Lv. 50): Victory Road 2F before Indigo Plateau.
Yellow.prerequisites: HM03 Surf and HM04 Strength

FireRed.location: Seafoam Islands / Power Plant / Mt. Ember
FireRed.instructions:
• Articuno (Lv. 50): Seafoam Islands B4F. Push boulders with Strength to calm the rapids.
• Zapdos (Lv. 50): Abandoned Power Plant near Route 10.
• Moltres (Lv. 50): Summit of Mt. Ember on Sevii One Island.

LeafGreen.location: Seafoam Islands / Power Plant / Mt. Ember
LeafGreen.instructions:
• Articuno (Lv. 50): Seafoam Islands B4F. Push boulders with Strength to calm the rapids.
• Zapdos (Lv. 50): Abandoned Power Plant near Route 10.
• Moltres (Lv. 50): Summit of Mt. Ember on Sevii One Island.
LeafGreen.prerequisites: HM03 Surf and HM04 Strength

weather_trio.name: Super-Ancient Weather Trio (Kyogre, Groudon, Rayquaza)
weather_trio.description: The titanic deities of land, sea, and ozone: Groudon, Kyogre, and Rayquaza.

Ruby.instructions: Awaken Groudon (Lv. 45) in the lowest chamber of the Cave of Origin with the Blue Orb. Groudon summons harsh sunlight and uses Fire Blast and Earthquake.
Ruby.prerequisites: Blue Orb and story progression to Sootopolis Gym

Sapphire.location: Cave of Origin (Sootopolis City)
Sapphire.instructions: Awaken Kyogre (Lv. 45) in the lowest chamber of the Cave of Origin with the Red Orb. Kyogre summons heavy rain and uses Hydro Pump and Ice Beam.
Sapphire.prerequisites: Red Orb and story progression to Sootopolis Gym

Emerald.instructions: Visit the Weather Institute on Route 119 post-game. The meteorologist will report heavy drought (Terra Cave: Groudon Lv. 70) or torrential rain (Marine Cave: Kyogre Lv. 70). Head to the reported route quickly before the anomaly relocates.
Emerald.prerequisites: Defeat the Elite Four / Champion Wallace

regi_trio.name: Legendary Titans & Sealed Chamber (Regirock, Regice, Registeel)
regi_trio.description: Unseal the Ancient Titans created from rock, ice, and magma by solving the Braille puzzle in Route 134 Sealed Chamber using Relicanth and Wailord.

Ruby.location: Route 134 Sealed Chamber / Desert Ruins / Island Cave / Ancient Tomb
Ruby.instructions:
1. Bring Relicanth (first party slot) and Wailord (last party slot) to Route 134 Sealed Chamber. Use Dig on the back wall, then read the Braille to unlock three distant doors across Hoenn.
2. Regirock (Lv. 40): Desert Ruins on Route 111.
3. Regice (Lv. 40): Island Cave on Route 105.
4. Registeel (Lv. 40): Ancient Tomb on Route 120.
Ruby.prerequisites: Relicanth, Wailord, HM08 Dive, TM28 Dig

Sapphire.location: Route 134 Sealed Chamber / Desert Ruins / Island Cave / Ancient Tomb
Sapphire.instructions:
1. Bring Relicanth (first party slot) and Wailord (last party slot) to Route 134 Sealed Chamber. Use Dig on the back wall, then read the Braille to unlock three distant doors across Hoenn.
2. Regirock (Lv. 40): Desert Ruins on Route 111.
3. Regice (Lv. 40): Island Cave on Route 105.
4. Registeel (Lv. 40): Ancient Tomb on Route 120.
Sapphire.prerequisites: Relicanth, Wailord, HM08 Dive, TM28 Dig

Emerald.location: Route 134 Sealed Chamber / Desert Ruins / Island Cave / Ancient Tomb
Emerald.instructions:
1. Bring Wailord (first party slot) and Relicanth (last party slot) to Route 134 Sealed Chamber. Use Dig on the back wall, then read the Braille to cause an earthquake unlocking three distant doors.
2. Regirock (Lv. 40): Desert Ruins on Route 111 (Left 2, Down 2, Use Rock Smash).
3. Regice (Lv. 40): Island Cave on Route 105 (Stay close to wall and run 1 clockwise lap).
4. Registeel (Lv. 40): Ancient Tomb on Route 120 (Stand in middle and use Flash).
Emerald.prerequisites: Relicanth, Wailord, HM08 Dive, TM28 Dig, HM05 Flash, HM06 Rock Smash

devon_scope.name: Devon Scope (Route 120 Invisible Kecleon)
devon_scope.description: Special high-tech optical scope developed by Devon Corporation that reveals camouflaged Kecleon blocking routes across Hoenn.
devon_scope.generalInstructions: Meet Steven Stone on the suspension bridge on Route 120 past Fortree City. He will hand you the Devon Scope and demonstrate its power on a camouflaged Kecleon.
devon_scope.generalPrerequisites: Feather Badge from Winona in Fortree Gym

Ruby.instructions: Cross the bridge east of Fortree City on Route 120. Steven Stone will give you the Devon Scope to detect invisible Kecleon blocking Fortree Gym and southern routes.
Ruby.prerequisites: Progress story to Fortree City

Sapphire.location: Route 120 Bridge (Steven Stone)
Sapphire.instructions: Meet Steven Stone on Route 120 bridge east of Fortree City to receive the Devon Scope.
Sapphire.prerequisites: Progress story to Fortree City

Emerald.instructions: Talk to Steven Stone on the Route 120 bridge. Use the Devon Scope to battle the invisible Lv. 30 Kecleon blocking the route and uncover the path to Fortree Gym.

liberty_pass.name: Liberty Pass & Liberty Garden (Victini Event)
liberty_pass.description: The ferry ticket granting passage aboard the Liberty Ship from Castelia City Pier to Liberty Garden Island to capture the mythical Victory Pokémon Victini.
liberty_pass.generalInstructions: Show the Liberty Pass at the westernmost pier in Castelia City. Ride the ferry to Liberty Garden, defeat Team Plasma grunts, and capture Lv. 15 Victini inside the lighthouse chamber.

Black.instructions: Take the ferry from Castelia City's Liberty Pier to Liberty Garden. Clear out Team Plasma grunts inside the lighthouse basement to battle and catch Lv. 15 mythical Victini.
Black.prerequisites: Liberty Pass key item

White.instructions: Take the ferry from Castelia City's Liberty Pier to Liberty Garden. Clear out Team Plasma grunts inside the lighthouse basement to battle and catch Lv. 15 mythical Victini.
White.prerequisites: Liberty Pass key item

dragon_scale.name: Dragon Scale (Kingdra Evolution)
dragon_scale.description: A thick and tough scale. When held by Seadra during a trade, it triggers evolution into the Dragon/Water powerhouse Kingdra.
dragon_scale.generalInstructions: Give the Dragon Scale to Seadra and trade it with another player to evolve into Kingdra.
dragon_scale.generalPrerequisites: Surf & Waterfall to reach deep cavern chambers

Gold.location: Mt. Mortar (Deep Upper Chamber)
Gold.instructions: Found in Mt. Mortar requiring Surf and Waterfall, or held by wild Horsea/Dratini (2% chance). Give to Seadra and trade to obtain Kingdra.
Gold.prerequisites: Surf and Waterfall

Emerald.instructions: Deep inside Meteor Falls in the chamber where Bagon spawns, or held by wild Horsea/Bagon (5% chance). Trade Seadra holding it to evolve Kingdra.

upgrade_dubious.name: Up-Grade & Dubious Disc (Porygon Evolutions)
upgrade_dubious.description: Advanced Silph Co. and Team Galactic digital data discs. Trade Porygon holding Up-Grade to evolve Porygon2; trade Porygon2 holding Dubious Disc to evolve Porygon-Z.
upgrade_dubious.generalInstructions:
1. Trade Porygon holding Up-Grade to evolve Porygon2.
2. Trade Porygon2 holding Dubious Disc to evolve Porygon-Z.
upgrade_dubious.generalPrerequisites: Access to Saffron Silph Co. or Veilstone Galactic HQ

FireRed.instructions: Obtain Up-Grade on 5F of Silph Co. in Saffron City. Trade Porygon holding it to evolve Porygon2.

Platinum.instructions: Up-Grade is given by Prof. Oak in Eterna City after obtaining National Dex. Dubious Disc is in Galactic Veilstone HQ. Trade Porygon with each to evolve Porygon2 and Porygon-Z.
Platinum.prerequisites: National Pokédex

protector.name: Protector (Rhyperior Evolution)
protector.description: A protective item as stiff and heavy as rock. When held by Rhydon during a trade, it evolves into the Ground/Rock juggernaut Rhyperior.
protector.generalInstructions: Equip Rhydon with the Protector and trade with another trainer to evolve into Rhyperior.

Diamond.instructions: Found on Route 228 in the northern sandstorm region of the Battle Zone. Equip Rhydon with the Protector and trade to evolve Rhyperior.
Diamond.prerequisites: National Pokédex

Platinum.instructions: Located in Iron Island B2F and along the rocky slopes of Route 228. Trade Rhydon holding Protector to evolve Rhyperior.
Platinum.prerequisites: Surf

link_cable.name: Linking Cord / Link Cable (Trade Evolution Item)
link_cable.description: A nostalgic cord exuding a curious bond. Use it directly like an evolution stone to evolve Kadabra (Alakazam), Machoke (Machamp), Graveler (Golem), and Haunter (Gengar) without trading!
link_cable.generalLocation: Jubilife Village Trading Post / Bori-dex Smart Inventory
link_cable.generalInstructions: Select Linking Cord from your satchel and use it directly on Kadabra, Machoke, Graveler, or Haunter to immediately trigger evolution into their final Stage 2 forms.
link_cable.generalPrerequisites: Merit Points (MP) in Hisui / Bori-dex Solo Evolution Engine

Emerald.instructions: In Bori-dex, trade evolutions can be achieved using the Linking Cord directly from your bag without needing a second physical Game Boy or link cable.

FireRed.instructions: Use the Linking Cord directly on Kadabra, Machoke, Haunter, or Graveler to evolve them without trading.

life_orb.name: Life Orb (1.3x Move Boost at 10% HP Cost)
life_orb.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the power of all attacking moves by 30% (1.3x), but the user loses 10% of their maximum HP after each successful attack.
life_orb.generalInstructions: Acquire from Stark Mountain post-game or redeem at Battle Frontier / Battle Subway for 48 Battle Points (BP).

Platinum.instructions: Located in the cavern depths of Stark Mountain in the Battle Zone, or exchangeable at Battle Frontier for 48 BP.
Platinum.prerequisites: Rock Climb, Strength, Surf

Emerald.instructions: Exchange 48 BP at the Battle Frontier Exchange Service Corner in eastern Hoenn.

assault_vest.name: Assault Vest (1.5x Special Defense Boost)
assault_vest.description: An offensive defensive vest to be held by a Pokémon. It raises Special Defense by 50% (1.5x), but completely prevents the holder from using status moves.
assault_vest.generalInstructions: Purchase at Delibird Presents or exchange at high-tier Battle Facilities. Ideal on bulky attackers like Tyranitar, Goodra, and Kingambit.

Scarlet.location: Mesagoza (Delibird Presents West)
Scarlet.instructions: Purchase for 40,000 Pokédollars at Delibird Presents in western Mesagoza after obtaining 4 Gym Badges, or found in Area Zero.
Scarlet.prerequisites: 4 Gym Badges

Violet.location: Mesagoza (Delibird Presents West)
Violet.instructions: Purchase for 40,000 Pokédollars at Delibird Presents in western Mesagoza after obtaining 4 Gym Badges, or found in Area Zero.

heavy_duty_boots.name: Heavy-Duty Boots (Hazard Immunity)
heavy_duty_boots.description: Footwear that completely prevents the wearer from taking damage or negative effects from entry hazards on the battlefield (Stealth Rock, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web).
heavy_duty_boots.generalInstructions: Essential held item for Fire and Flying types with 4x Rock weaknesses (Charizard, Volcarona, Talonflame).

Scarlet.location: Levincia (Delibird Presents)
Scarlet.instructions: Purchase for 20,000 Pokédollars at Delibird Presents in coastal Levincia after defeating 4 Gym Leaders.
Scarlet.prerequisites: 4 Gym Badges

Violet.location: Levincia (Delibird Presents)
Violet.instructions: Purchase for 20,000 Pokédollars at Delibird Presents in coastal Levincia after defeating 4 Gym Leaders.

ability_patch.name: Ability Patch (Unlock Hidden Ability)
ability_patch.description: A high-tier patch that immediately unlocks the rare Hidden Ability of any Pokémon. Irreversible upgrade.
ability_patch.generalLocation: 6-Star Tera Raids (Paldea) / Max Lair Dynite Ore
ability_patch.generalInstructions: Clear 6-Star black crystal Tera Raid Dens in Paldea, or exchange 200 Dynite Ore with the Crown Tundra Max Lair specialist.
ability_patch.generalPrerequisites: Post-game Academy Ace Tournament or Crown Tundra expansion

Scarlet.location: 6-Star Tera Raid Dens (Black Tera Crystals)
Scarlet.instructions: Complete the Academy Ace Tournament and win 10 5-star raids to unlock black 6-Star Tera Dens. Defeat 6-star bosses (4.5% drop rate) for Ability Patches.
Scarlet.prerequisites: Post-game Ace Tournament

Violet.location: 6-Star Tera Raid Dens (Black Tera Crystals)
Violet.instructions: Complete the Academy Ace Tournament and win 10 5-star raids to unlock black 6-Star Tera Dens. Defeat 6-star bosses (4.5% drop rate) for Ability Patches.

psyduck_headache.name: Psyduck Headache Roadblock (Route 210)
psyduck_headache.description: A flock of disoriented Psyduck holding their heads in agony, completely blocking Route 210 north toward Celestic Town.
psyduck_headache.generalInstructions: Defeat Team Galactic at the Pastoria Great Marsh gate. Chase the Galactic Grunt east to Lake Valor and talk to Cynthia. She gifts you the SecretPotion. Spray the Psyduck to cure their chronic headaches and clear Route 210.
psyduck_headache.generalPrerequisites: Fen Badge from Crasher Wake & SecretPotion from Cynthia

Diamond.instructions: Use Cynthia's SecretPotion on the flock of Psyduck on Route 210 to cure their headaches and unlock the mountain pass to Celestic Town.
Diamond.prerequisites: Fen Badge & Cynthia's SecretPotion

Pearl.instructions: Use Cynthia's SecretPotion on the flock of Psyduck on Route 210 to cure their headaches and unlock the mountain pass to Celestic Town.
Pearl.prerequisites: Fen Badge & Cynthia's SecretPotion

Platinum.instructions: Chase the Galactic Grunt from Pastoria to Lake Valor. Meet Cynthia on Route 214; she gives you the SecretPotion. Use it on the Psyduck on Route 210 to open the road to Celestic Town.
Platinum.prerequisites: Fen Badge & Cynthia's SecretPotion

route_110_blockade.name: Route 110 Team Aqua/Magma Blockade
route_110_blockade.description: Villainous Team Aqua/Magma grunts crowding the entrance to Route 110 and the Slateport Oceanic Museum.
route_110_blockade.generalInstructions: Pay 50 Pokédollars to enter the Slateport Oceanic Museum on the east side of town. Go upstairs to 2F, deliver the Devon Goods to Captain Stern, and defeat the villainous team grunts to clear Route 110.
route_110_blockade.generalPrerequisites: Devon Goods recovered from Rusturf Tunnel

Ruby.instructions: Defeat Team Magma on 2F of the Oceanic Museum to deliver the Devon Goods. The grunts will vacate Route 110, allowing passage to Mauville City.
Ruby.prerequisites: Devon Goods

Sapphire.location: Slateport City (Oceanic Museum)
Sapphire.instructions: Defeat Team Aqua on 2F of the Oceanic Museum to deliver the Devon Goods. The grunts will clear Route 110.
Sapphire.prerequisites: Devon Goods

Emerald.instructions: Defeat Team Aqua on 2F of the Oceanic Museum, hand Captain Stern the Devon Goods, and proceed north along Route 110 toward Mauville City.

devon_goods_quest.name: Devon Goods & Peeko Rescue (Rusturf Tunnel)
devon_goods_quest.description: A Team Aqua/Magma grunt has mugged a Devon researcher and kidnapped Mr. Briney's beloved Wingull, Peeko, inside Rusturf Tunnel.
devon_goods_quest.generalInstructions: Enter Rusturf Tunnel east of Rustboro City. Corner the villainous grunt, defeat him in battle, and recover the Devon Goods. Mr. Briney will rescue Peeko and offer you free boat rides from Route 104 to Dewford Island!
devon_goods_quest.generalPrerequisites: Stone Badge from Roxanne in Rustboro Gym

Ruby.instructions: Defeat the Team Magma Grunt in Rusturf Tunnel. Return the Devon Goods to the Devon Corp researcher outside to receive Great Balls and access to President Stone.
Ruby.prerequisites: Stone Badge

Sapphire.location: Rusturf Tunnel (Rustboro East)
Sapphire.instructions: Defeat the Team Aqua Grunt in Rusturf Tunnel. Recover Peeko and the Devon Goods.
Sapphire.prerequisites: Stone Badge

Emerald.instructions: Defeat the Team Aqua Grunt in Rusturf Tunnel. Return Peeko to Mr. Briney on Route 104 and give the Devon Goods to the researcher to earn the Letter for Steven.

silph_co_invasion.name: Silph Co. Team Rocket Invasion & Card Key
silph_co_invasion.description: Team Rocket has seized control of Silph Co.'s 11-story headquarters in Saffron City to steal the prototype Master Ball.
silph_co_invasion.generalInstructions:
1. Enter Silph Co. in center Saffron City.
2. Navigate to 5F south corridor to pick up the Card Key.
3. Open electronic doors, warp from 3F to 7F for Rival battle & free Lapras.
4. Take warp on 11F to defeat Giovanni and receive the Master Ball from the President.
silph_co_invasion.generalPrerequisites: Rainbow Badge from Erika & Celadon Rocket Hideout cleared

Red.location: Silph Co. (Saffron City)
Red.instructions: Find the Card Key on 5F. Unlock doors, rescue Lapras on 7F, defeat Giovanni on 11F, and receive the Master Ball.
Red.prerequisites: Silph Scope / Celadon Hideout cleared

FireRed.instructions: Acquire Card Key on 5F, defeat Rival on 7F to obtain Lapras, defeat Giovanni on 11F, and talk to President for the Master Ball.

power_plant_part.name: Stolen Machine Part (Cerulean Gym / Kanto Power Plant)
power_plant_part.description: A foreign Team Rocket member stole an essential generator component from the Kanto Power Plant, causing a blackout across the region.
power_plant_part.generalLocation: Cerulean City Gym / Kanto Power Plant
power_plant_part.generalInstructions:
1. Visit the Power Plant on Route 10 to learn of the stolen part.
2. Go to Cerulean Gym and encounter the foreign Rocket grunt.
3. Pursue him north to Route 24 Nugget Bridge and defeat him.
4. Inspect the inner square pool in Cerulean Gym to fish out the Machine Part.
5. Return it to the Power Plant manager to restore electricity across Kanto!
power_plant_part.generalPrerequisites: Defeat Johto Elite Four & Arrive in Kanto

Gold.location: Cerulean Gym / Route 10 Power Plant
Gold.instructions: Defeat the foreign Rocket grunt on Route 24. Find the Machine Part hidden in the center of the Cerulean Gym swimming pool. Return it to the Power Plant on Route 10 to restore power and earn TM07 Zap Cannon.
Gold.prerequisites: Arrive in Kanto via S.S. Aqua

HeartGold.instructions: Defeat the Rocket grunt on Nugget Bridge. Dive/surf into the Cerulean Gym pool to locate the Machine Part. Deliver it to the Power Plant director to restart the Magnet Train and Lavender Radio Tower.

dowsing_radar_spots.name: Dowsing Radar & Invisible Route Items
dowsing_radar_spots.description: Guide to detecting high-value invisible items (PP Max, Sacred Ash, Leftovers, Nuggets) using the Dowsing Machine / Itemfinder.
dowsing_radar_spots.generalLocation: Routes & Dead Ends Across All Regions
dowsing_radar_spots.generalInstructions: Equip the Dowsing Machine / Itemfinder in corners, tree cutouts, flower patches, and sand craters where visible Poké Balls are absent.

Emerald.instructions: Use Itemfinder to locate hidden Rare Candies, PP Ups, and Ultra Balls in Jagged Pass ash craters and Route 120 tall grass.

FireRed.instructions: Stand on the exact tile where Snorlax was sleeping on Route 12 and Route 16 and activate the Itemfinder to uncover hidden Leftovers!

hidden_rare_candies.name: Hidden Rare Candies (Free Leveling Spots)
hidden_rare_candies.description: Locations of completely invisible, free Rare Candies scattered across classic regional routes.
hidden_rare_candies.generalLocation: Mt. Moon, Cycling Road, Trick House, Wayward Cave
hidden_rare_candies.generalInstructions: Inspect solitary rocks, dead-end trees, and beach sand craters using the A button.

Red.location: Mt. Moon B2F & Route 17 (Cycling Road)
Red.instructions:
1. Mt. Moon B2F: Inspect the isolated rock near the Super Nerd.
2. Route 17: In the center grass path of Cycling Road.
3. Cerulean City: In the backyard of the robbed house.
Red.prerequisites: Bicycle / Itemfinder

Emerald.instructions:
1. Petalburg Woods: In the fenced inlet requiring Cut.
2. Route 108: Surf to the rocky inlet outside Abandoned Ship.
3. Route 119: Behind the waterfall near Weather Institute.

buried_fossils.name: Buried Fossils & Prehistoric Pokémon
buried_fossils.description: Prehistoric biological specimens buried in stone: Helix (Omanyte), Dome (Kabuto), Old Amber (Aerodactyl), Root (Lileep), Claw (Anorith), Skull (Cranidos), and Armor (Shieldon).
buried_fossils.generalLocation: Mt. Moon, Mirage Tower, Mining Museum
buried_fossils.generalInstructions: Excavate fossils from ruins or desert sands and deliver them to regional laboratory scientists to regenerate living prehistoric Pokémon.
buried_fossils.generalPrerequisites: Explorer Kit or Rock Smash / Desert Goggles

Red.location: Mt. Moon & Cinnabar Island Pokémon Lab
Red.instructions: Choose Helix Fossil (Omanyte) or Dome Fossil (Kabuto) at Mt. Moon B2F. Take Old Amber from Pewter Museum back door. Revive all 3 at Cinnabar Island Lab.
Red.prerequisites: Surf to Cinnabar Island

Emerald.instructions: Scale the crumbling Mirage Tower on Route 111 using the Mach Bike. Select Claw Fossil (Anorith) or Root Fossil (Lileep). The other sinks into the desert but re-emerges post-game in Desert Underpass. Revive on 2F of Devon Corp in Rustboro.

daily_berry_trees.name: Daily Berry Trees & Soil Master
daily_berry_trees.description: Locations of renewable soft-soil berry plots and daily gift specialists across Hoenn and Sinnoh.
daily_berry_trees.generalInstructions: Visit the Berry Master's house on Route 123 daily for two rare berries. Plant berries in soft loamy soil and water regularly with the Wailmer Pail.

Emerald.instructions: Visit the Berry Master on Route 123 daily for two free berries. Tell his wife special phrases like 'CHALLENGE CONTEST' or 'OVERWHELMING LATIAS' to unlock rare Lum, Pamtre, and Watmel berries.

ruin_of_alph_puzzles.name: Ruins of Alph Sliding Tile Puzzles (Unown Secrets)
ruin_of_alph_puzzles.description: Four ancient stone chambers containing sliding picture puzzles of Kabuto, Omanyte, Aerodactyl, and Ho-Oh that unlock 28 Unown forms and secret treasure vaults.
ruin_of_alph_puzzles.generalLocation: Ruins of Alph (South of Violet City)
ruin_of_alph_puzzles.generalInstructions:
1. Kabuto Puzzle: Main chamber, accessible immediately.
2. Omanyte Puzzle: Requires Surf across water.
3. Aerodactyl Puzzle: Access via Union Cave B2F with Surf.
4. Ho-Oh Puzzle: Access via Union Cave with Strength.
5. Hidden back rooms: Use Escape Rope, Flash, Water Stone, and Ho-Oh in first party slot.

Gold.location: Ruins of Alph (Violet City South)
Gold.instructions: Solve the Kabuto picture puzzle to awaken Unown forms A-K. Solve Omanyte, Aerodactyl, and Ho-Oh puzzles via Union Cave to unlock all 26 alphabet forms and Unown Dex.
Gold.prerequisites: Surf & Strength

HeartGold.instructions: Solve all 4 stone puzzles. Crack the secret wall inscriptions by using an Escape Rope, Flash, Water Stone, and holding Ho-Oh to collect ancient Arceus Plates.

tanoby_ruins_cipher.name: Tanoby Ruins & Dotted Hole Braille Cipher
tanoby_ruins_cipher.description: Seven solitary island chambers on Sevii Seven Island containing Unown, unlocked by solving the Dotted Hole Braille Cut puzzle on Sevii Six Island.
tanoby_ruins_cipher.generalLocation: Sevii Island Six (Dotted Hole) & Seven (Tanoby Chambers)
tanoby_ruins_cipher.generalInstructions:
1. Enter Dotted Hole on Ruin Valley (Six Island).
2. Read Braille: 'CUT'. Use HM01 Cut on the door.
3. Drop into holes: Up, Left, Right, Down.
4. Recover Sapphire and travel to Tanoby Ruins (Seven Island) to catch Unown ? and ! forms.

FireRed.location: Sevii Six (Dotted Hole) & Sevii Seven (Tanoby Ruins)
FireRed.instructions: Solve the Dotted Hole puzzle on Six Island (Cut the door, drop Up, Left, Right, Down). Deliver the Sapphire to Celio to unlock the Tanoby Chambers on Seven Island.

LeafGreen.location: Sevii Six (Dotted Hole) & Sevii Seven (Tanoby Ruins)
LeafGreen.instructions: Solve the Dotted Hole puzzle on Six Island (Cut the door, drop Up, Left, Right, Down). Deliver the Sapphire to Celio to unlock the Tanoby Chambers on Seven Island.
LeafGreen.prerequisites: HM01 Cut & Rainbow Pass

abyssal_ruins_alphabet.name: Abyssal Ruins Ancient Cipher & Relic Treasures
abyssal_ruins_alphabet.description: A colossal submerged labyrinth beneath Undella Bay in Unova. Features ancient cipher walls and 16 Arceus Elemental Plates plus Relic Gold worth millions of Pokédollars.
abyssal_ruins_alphabet.generalInstructions: Use HM06 Dive at dark water spots in Undella Bay. You have 500 steps before the tide expels you. Translate the cipher walls (King's Epitaph) and collect the Ancient Crown on 4F.
abyssal_ruins_alphabet.generalPrerequisites: HM06 Dive (from Cynthia in Undella Town)

Black.instructions: Dive into the Abyssal Ruins. Collect all 16 Elemental Plates and Ancient Relics to sell to the billionaire connoisseur in Undella Town for 1,700,000 Pokédollars.
Black.prerequisites: HM06 Dive

White.instructions: Dive into the Abyssal Ruins. Collect all 16 Elemental Plates and Ancient Relics to sell to the billionaire connoisseur in Undella Town for 1,700,000 Pokédollars.
White.prerequisites: HM06 Dive

ice_path_sliding_puzzles.name: Ice Path Frictionless Sliding & Boulder Puzzles
ice_path_sliding_puzzles.description: A treacherous frozen cave connecting Mahogany Town to Blackthorn City. Features frictionless ice rinks and four Strength boulders on B2F that must be dropped into holes to form stepping stones on B3F.
ice_path_sliding_puzzles.generalInstructions:
1. 1F Ice Rink: Up, Left, Up, Right, Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right, Down, Right, Up, Right.
2. B2F Strength Puzzles: Push all 4 boulders into holes.
3. B3F: Jump across the fallen boulders to safely collect HM07 Waterfall and exit to Blackthorn City.
ice_path_sliding_puzzles.generalPrerequisites: HM04 Strength & Glacier Badge from Pryce

Gold.location: Ice Path (Johto Route 44)
Gold.instructions: Navigate frictionless ice rinks and push 4 boulders on B2F into matching holes to cross B3F and collect HM07 Waterfall.
Gold.prerequisites: HM04 Strength

HeartGold.instructions: Push all 4 Strength boulders into the holes on B2F to create stepping stones on B3F. Collect HM07 Waterfall and exit into Blackthorn City.

lt_surge_trash_can_switches.name: Lt. Surge Vermilion Gym (Electric Lock Trash Can Puzzle)
lt_surge_trash_can_switches.description: 15 trash cans with concealed electric switches protecting Gym Leader Lt. Surge. Finding the first switch activates the second switch in an immediately adjacent trash can.
lt_surge_trash_can_switches.generalInstructions:
1. Check trash cans until you find the First Switch.
2. The Second Switch is ALWAYS in one of the 4 adjacent cans (North, South, East, West).
3. If you pick wrong, the lasers reset and the first switch randomizes!
lt_surge_trash_can_switches.generalPrerequisites: HM01 Cut to chop tree blocking gym

Red.location: Vermilion City Gym
Red.instructions: Search the 15 trash cans. Once Switch 1 is found, immediately inspect adjacent cans (North, South, East, West) to open the laser gate to Lt. Surge (Lv. 24 Raichu).
Red.prerequisites: HM01 Cut

FireRed.instructions: Find Switch 1 in the trash cans, then search the adjacent cardinal can for Switch 2. Save your game before checking the second can to avoid full resets!

silph_co_warp_pads.name: Silph Co. 11-Floor Warp Tile Maze
silph_co_warp_pads.description: The labyrinthine warp pad teleporter system connecting the 11 floors of Silph Co. headquarters in Saffron City.
silph_co_warp_pads.generalInstructions:
Fastest Route to Giovanni:
1. 5F: Pick up Card Key in south hallway.
2. 3F: Open central locked door and step on the left warp tile.
3. Arrive on 7F: Defeat Rival Blue, receive free Lapras from Silph worker.
4. Step on right warp tile to arrive on 11F outside President's Boardroom to defeat Giovanni!

Red.location: Silph Co. (Saffron City)
Red.instructions: Take Card Key from 5F south corridor. Warp from 3F central door to 7F, defeat Rival, talk to employee for Lv. 15 Lapras, and take adjacent warp directly to Giovanni on 11F.
Red.prerequisites: Card Key

FireRed.instructions: Card Key on 5F -> Warp from 3F to 7F -> Free Lapras & Rival battle -> 11F Giovanni showdown for Master Ball.

sabrina_gym_warp_maze.name: Sabrina Saffron Gym (Teleporter Room Maze)
sabrina_gym_warp_maze.description: The psychic teleporter puzzle inside Saffron City Gym featuring interconnected 4-warp floating rooms.
sabrina_gym_warp_maze.generalInstructions: Simple Rule to reach Sabrina in 4 warps: From the entrance room, step on the first warp pad. In every subsequent room, step on the pad that is DIAGONALLY OPPOSITE to the one you just arrived on (Top-Left <-> Bottom-Right, Top-Right <-> Bottom-Left)!
sabrina_gym_warp_maze.generalPrerequisites: Clear Silph Co. Team Rocket Invasion

Red.location: Saffron City Gym
Red.instructions: From each room, always step on the diagonally opposite teleporter pad to arrive straight in Sabrina's chamber (Lv. 43 Alakazam).
Red.prerequisites: Silph Co. cleared

FireRed.instructions: Step on the diagonally opposite teleporter in every room to bypass the maze and battle Sabrina.

sootopolis_gym_ice_tiles.name: Sootopolis Gym 1-Pass Cracked Ice Floor Puzzle
sootopolis_gym_ice_tiles.description: Three consecutive cracked ice tile challenges in Sootopolis Gym. You must step on every single ice tile exactly once to turn them solid; stepping on any tile twice breaks the floor and drops you into the basement!
sootopolis_gym_ice_tiles.generalInstructions:
Floor 1: Trace the perimeter clockwise.
Floor 2: Snaking S-pattern from left to right.
Floor 3: Start bottom-left, loop outer edges, then fill inner horseshoe, stepping onto the stairs as your final move!
sootopolis_gym_ice_tiles.generalPrerequisites: Awaken/Catch Kyogre or Groudon in Cave of Origin

Emerald.instructions: Step on every cracked ice tile once without crossing your path to deploy stairs to Gym Leader Juan (Lv. 46 Kingdra).

Ruby.instructions: Step on every ice tile once to freeze them solid and unlock Gym Leader Wallace.
Ruby.prerequisites: Cave of Origin cleared

master_ball_targets.name: Best Pokémon for Master Ball (Every Game Gen 1–9 Guide)
aliases: what pokemon to use master ball on
who should i use master ball on
master_ball_targets.description: Complete game-by-game tactical breakdown of the #1 best Pokémon (and Runner-Up) to catch with your Master Ball in every mainline cartridge, with map pins pointing directly to the target Pokémon's habitat.
master_ball_targets.generalLocation: Cerulean Cave (Kanto), Burned Tower/Routes (Johto), Sky Pillar (Hoenn), Spear Pillar/Routes (Sinnoh), Giant Chasm (Unova), Unknown Dungeon (Kalos), Ultra Space (Alola), Crown Shrine (Galar), Area Zero (Paldea)
master_ball_targets.generalInstructions:
Golden Rule of Master Balls:
• Gen 1 (R/B/Y) & Gen 6 (X/Y) & Let's Go: Lv. 70 Mewtwo (Cerulean Cave / Unknown Dungeon).
• Gen 2 (G/S/C/HG/SS): Roaming Raikou or Entei (flee on Turn 1 + carry Roar).
• Gen 3 (R/S/E): Roaming Latias/Latios or Lv. 70 Sky Pillar Rayquaza.
• FireRed/LeafGreen: Roaming Raikou/Entei (CRITICAL: their Roar bug permanently deletes them from your save!).
• Gen 4 (D/P/Pt/BDSP): Roaming Mesprit/Cresselia/Kanto Birds or Lv. 80 Arceus (NEVER Dialga/Palkia — catch rate 30!).
• Gen 5 (B/W/B2/W2): Roaming Tornadus/Thundurus (BW) or Lv. 70 Kyurem (B2W2) (NEVER Reshiram/Zekrom — catch rate 45!).
• ORAS: Lv. 80 Deoxys in Space during the Delta Episode (fought right after Rayquaza with no save break).
• Gen 7 (SM/USUM): Lv. 75 Necrozma / Tapu Fini (SM) or Ultra Warp Ride Shiny/Box Legendaries (USUM).
• Gen 8 (SwSh): Lv. 80 Calyrex, Galarian Birds, or Shiny G-Max Raids (NEVER Eternatus or Max Lair bosses — 100% catch rate!).
• Gen 9 (SV): Lv. 72 Second Koraidon/Miraidon or Four Treasures of Ruin (NEVER Ogerpon or Terapagos — 100% catch rate!).

Red.location: Cerulean Cave B1F — #1 Target: Mewtwo (Lv. 70)
Red.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Mewtwo (Lv. 70, Cerulean Cave B1F). Base catch rate 3, spams Recover (restores 50% HP), Psychic, and Amnesia (+2 Special). In Gen 1, Ultra Balls can completely miss Mewtwo unless it is Asleep or Frozen, making Mewtwo the undisputed #1 Master Ball target!
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Articuno (Seafoam Islands), Zapdos (Power Plant), or Moltres (Victory Road) — all 3 are stationary and lack recovery moves, so use Ultra Balls + Sleep Powder on the birds.
Red.prerequisites: Enter Hall of Fame to unlock Cerulean Cave

Blue.location: Cerulean Cave B1F — #1 Target: Mewtwo (Lv. 70)
Blue.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Mewtwo (Lv. 70, Cerulean Cave B1F). Catch rate 3 with infinite PP Recover and Amnesia. Throw the Master Ball on Turn 1!
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Zapdos (Power Plant) or Articuno (Seafoam Islands).
Blue.prerequisites: Enter Hall of Fame to unlock Cerulean Cave

Yellow.location: Cerulean Cave B1F — #1 Target: Mewtwo (Lv. 70)
Yellow.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Mewtwo (Lv. 70, Cerulean Cave B1F). Catch rate 3 with Recover. Save your Master Ball exclusively for Mewtwo!
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Zapdos (Power Plant) or Moltres (Victory Road).
Yellow.prerequisites: Enter Hall of Fame to unlock Cerulean Cave

Gold.location: Burned Tower / Johto Routes — #1 Target: Roaming Raikou or Entei (Lv. 40)
Gold.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Raikou or Entei (Lv. 40 Johto Roamers). Released from Burned Tower in Ecruteak City, both roam Johto's routes, flee immediately on Turn 1 (even while asleep unless Mean Look is active), and know Roar to force-end the battle!
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Lugia (Lv. 70 in Gold at Whirl Islands) or Ho-Oh (Lv. 40 at Tin Tower) — both are stationary so you can save right in front of them.
Gold.prerequisites: Awaken the 3 Legendary Beasts in Burned Tower B1F

Silver.location: Burned Tower / Johto Routes — #1 Target: Roaming Raikou or Entei (Lv. 40)
Silver.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Raikou or Entei (Lv. 40 Johto Roamers). Flee on Turn 1 and carry Roar.
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Ho-Oh (Lv. 70 in Silver at Tin Tower) or Lugia (Lv. 40 at Whirl Islands).
Silver.prerequisites: Awaken the 3 Legendary Beasts in Burned Tower B1F

Crystal.location: Johto Routes — #1 Target: Roaming Raikou or Entei (Required for Ho-Oh!)
Crystal.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Raikou or Entei (Lv. 40 Johto Roamers). In Crystal, you MUST capture Suicune (stationary at Tin Tower) AND both roaming Raikou and Entei to unlock Ho-Oh! Use your Master Ball on Raikou or Entei to cut the roaming grind in half.
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Lugia (Lv. 60, Whirl Islands) or Ho-Oh (Lv. 60, Tin Tower).
Crystal.prerequisites: Awaken the Beasts at Burned Tower

Ruby.location: Hoenn Routes / Sky Pillar — #1 Target: Roaming Latios (Lv. 40) or Rayquaza (Lv. 70)
Ruby.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Roaming Latios (Lv. 40 across Hoenn routes after the Elite Four). Flees on Turn 1 unless trapped by Wobbuffet's Shadow Tag.
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Rayquaza (Lv. 70, Sky Pillar — knows Outrage which confuses itself and Rest which heals to full HP).
Ruby.prerequisites: Beat Elite Four (Latios) or Reach Sky Pillar

Sapphire.location: Hoenn Routes / Sky Pillar — #1 Target: Roaming Latias (Lv. 40) or Rayquaza (Lv. 70)
Sapphire.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Roaming Latias (Lv. 40 across Hoenn routes post-game). Flees immediately on Turn 1.
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Rayquaza (Lv. 70, Sky Pillar) or Kyogre (Lv. 45, Cave of Origin).
Sapphire.prerequisites: Beat Elite Four (Latias) or Reach Sky Pillar

Emerald.location: Hoenn Routes / Sky Pillar — #1 Target: Roaming Latias/Latios (Lv. 40) or Rayquaza (Lv. 70)
Emerald.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Roaming Latias or Latios (Lv. 40 post-game; chosen via the TV broadcast in Littleroot Town). Flees immediately on Turn 1.
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Rayquaza (Lv. 70 at Sky Pillar BEFORE the 8th Gym — catching Rayquaza at Lv. 70 with the Master Ball lets it solo the entire Elite Four!).
Emerald.prerequisites: Sky Pillar (pre-8th Gym) or Post-Game TV Choice

FireRed.location: Kanto Routes / Cerulean Cave — #1 Target: Roaming Raikou/Entei (Roar Glitch!) or Mewtwo
FireRed.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Roaming Raikou (if you picked Squirtle), Entei (if you picked Bulbasaur), or Suicune (if you picked Charmander). ⚠️ CRITICAL GEN 3 BUG: In FireRed/LeafGreen, if wild Raikou or Entei uses ROAR in battle, a game bug permanently deletes it from your save file forever! Always throw the Master Ball at your Roaming Beast!
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Mewtwo (Lv. 70, Cerulean Cave B1F — catch rate 3, Recover + Safeguard).
FireRed.prerequisites: Fix Celio's Network Machine on One Island (Post-Game)

LeafGreen.location: Kanto Routes / Cerulean Cave — #1 Target: Roaming Raikou/Entei (Roar Glitch!) or Mewtwo
LeafGreen.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Roaming Raikou, Entei, or Suicune (Lv. 50 across Kanto routes). ⚠️ CRITICAL BUG: Raikou and Entei know Roar, which permanently erases them from your save file if used in the wild in FRLG! Throw the Master Ball immediately.
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Mewtwo (Lv. 70, Cerulean Cave B1F).
LeafGreen.prerequisites: Fix Celio's Network Machine on One Island (Post-Game)

Diamond.location: Lake Verity / Fullmoon Island — #1 Target: Roaming Mesprit or Cresselia (Lv. 50)
Diamond.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Mesprit (Lv. 50, Lake Verity) or Cresselia (Lv. 50, Fullmoon Island). Both roam Sinnoh and flee on Turn 1. ⚠️ NEVER use the Master Ball on Dialga at Spear Pillar—Dialga's catch rate is 30 (10x higher than normal legendaries)!
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Giratina (Lv. 70, Turnback Cave) or Heatran (Lv. 70, Stark Mountain).
Diamond.prerequisites: Visit Lake Verity Cavern or Fullmoon Island

Pearl.location: Lake Verity / Fullmoon Island — #1 Target: Roaming Mesprit or Cresselia (Lv. 50)
Pearl.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Mesprit (Lv. 50) or Cresselia (Lv. 50). Both flee on Turn 1 across Sinnoh. ⚠️ Do NOT waste on Palkia (catch rate 30, easy in Net/Dusk Balls)!
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Giratina (Lv. 70, Turnback Cave) or Heatran (Lv. 70, Stark Mountain).
Pearl.prerequisites: Visit Lake Verity Cavern or Fullmoon Island

Platinum.location: Sinnoh Routes — #1 Target: Mesprit, Cresselia, or Roaming Articuno/Zapdos/Moltres
Platinum.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Any of Platinum's FIVE Roaming Legendaries — Mesprit (Lv. 50), Cresselia (Lv. 50), Articuno (Lv. 60), Zapdos (Lv. 60), or Moltres (Lv. 60)! All 5 flee on Turn 1.
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Origin Giratina (Lv. 47, Distortion World) or Arceus (Lv. 80, Hall of Origin).
Platinum.prerequisites: Visit Lake Verity, Fullmoon Island, or Prof. Oak in Eterna City

HeartGold.location: Johto & Kanto Routes — #1 Target: Roaming Raikou, Entei, or Latias
HeartGold.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Roaming Raikou (Lv. 40), Entei (Lv. 40), or Latias (Lv. 35 in Kanto). All three flee immediately on Turn 1.
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Mewtwo (Lv. 70, Cerulean Cave) or Ho-Oh (Lv. 45, Bell Tower).
HeartGold.prerequisites: Burned Tower (Raikou/Entei) or Saffron Copycat Quest (Latias)

SoulSilver.location: Johto & Kanto Routes — #1 Target: Roaming Raikou, Entei, or Latios
SoulSilver.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Roaming Raikou (Lv. 40), Entei (Lv. 40), or Latios (Lv. 35 in Kanto). All three flee on Turn 1.
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Mewtwo (Lv. 70, Cerulean Cave) or Lugia (Lv. 45, Whirl Islands).
SoulSilver.prerequisites: Burned Tower (Raikou/Entei) or Saffron Copycat Quest (Latios)

Black.location: Route 7 / Unova Storm Routes — #1 Target: Roaming Tornadus (Lv. 40) or Kyurem (Lv. 75)
Black.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Roaming Tornadus (Lv. 40). Summons rainstorms on Unova routes and flees on Turn 1! ⚠️ NEVER use the Master Ball on Reshiram at N's Castle (catch rate 45, 15x easier than normal legendaries)!
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Kyurem (Lv. 75, Giant Chasm — catch rate 3).
Black.prerequisites: Event in Route 7 Cabin after 8th Gym Badge

White.location: Route 7 / Unova Storm Routes — #1 Target: Roaming Thundurus (Lv. 40) or Kyurem (Lv. 75)
White.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Roaming Thundurus (Lv. 40). Flees on Turn 1 inside Unova thunderstorms. ⚠️ Do NOT waste on Zekrom (catch rate 45)!
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Kyurem (Lv. 75, Giant Chasm — catch rate 3).
White.prerequisites: Event in Route 7 Cabin after 8th Gym Badge

Black 2.location: Giant Chasm — #1 Target: Kyurem (Lv. 70) & Latios (Lv. 68, Dreamyard)
Black 2.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Kyurem (Lv. 70, Giant Chasm post-game, catch rate 3). Unlocks the DNA Splicers to fuse Black Kyurem! (Zekrom at Dragonspiral Tower has catch rate 45).
🥈 RUNNER-UP (With 2nd Master Ball from Colress): Latios (Lv. 68, Dreamyard) or Cresselia (Marvelous Bridge).
Black 2.prerequisites: Catch Zekrom at Dragonspiral Tower (Post-Game)

White 2.location: Giant Chasm — #1 Target: Kyurem (Lv. 70) & Latias (Lv. 68, Dreamyard)
White 2.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Kyurem (Lv. 70, Giant Chasm post-game, catch rate 3). Unlocks the DNA Splicers to fuse White Kyurem!
🥈 RUNNER-UP (With 2nd Master Ball from Colress): Latias (Lv. 68, Dreamyard) or Cresselia (Marvelous Bridge).
White 2.prerequisites: Catch Reshiram at Dragonspiral Tower (Post-Game)

X.location: Unknown Dungeon (Pokémon Village) — #1 Target: Mewtwo (Lv. 70)
X.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Mewtwo (Lv. 70, Unknown Dungeon in Pokémon Village). Catch rate 3 and spams Recover. ⚠️ Do NOT waste on Xerneas (catch rate 45) or the roaming Kanto Bird (which flees automatically 11 times before sitting stationary at Sea Spirit's Den)!
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Zygarde (Lv. 70, Terminus Cave).
X.prerequisites: Enter Hall of Fame

Y.location: Unknown Dungeon (Pokémon Village) — #1 Target: Mewtwo (Lv. 70)
Y.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Mewtwo (Lv. 70, Unknown Dungeon in Pokémon Village). Catch rate 3 with Recover. ⚠️ Do NOT waste on Yveltal (catch rate 45)!
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Zygarde (Lv. 70, Terminus Cave).
Y.prerequisites: Enter Hall of Fame

Omega Ruby.location: Sky Pillar Apex (Space) — #1 Target: Deoxys (Lv. 80, Delta Episode)
Omega Ruby.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Deoxys (Lv. 80 in Space during the Delta Episode). Fought immediately after Rayquaza with NO save break in between, catch rate 3, and knows Recover + Cosmic Power! (Rayquaza has an easy story catch rate of 45, so use Ultra Balls on Rayquaza and throw your Master Ball at Deoxys!).
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Primal Groudon (Cave of Origin) or Mirage Spot Legendaries.
Omega Ruby.prerequisites: Complete Delta Episode at Sky Pillar

Alpha Sapphire.location: Sky Pillar Apex (Space) — #1 Target: Deoxys (Lv. 80, Delta Episode)
Alpha Sapphire.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Deoxys (Lv. 80 in Space during the Delta Episode). Immediately follows Rayquaza without a save point, catch rate 3, and spams Recover.
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Primal Kyogre (Cave of Origin, knows Aqua Ring) or Mirage Spot Legendaries.
Alpha Sapphire.prerequisites: Complete Delta Episode at Sky Pillar

Sun.location: Ten Carat Hill / Ruins of Hope — #1 Target: Necrozma (Lv. 75) or Tapu Fini / Tapu Lele
Sun.instructions: 🏆 #1 TARGET: Necrozma (Lv. 75 in Ten Carat Hill Farthest Hollow, catch rate 3 in SM) or Tapu Fini / Tapu Lele (Lv. 60, catch rate 3; Tapu Fini uses Aqua Ring + Nature's Madness). ⚠️ Use Beast Balls (5x) on Ultra Beasts, and Ultra Balls on Solgaleo (catch rate 45)!
Sun.prerequisites: Complete Ultra Beast Post-Game Missions

Moon.location: Ten Carat Hill / Ruins of Hope — #1 Target: Necrozma (Lv. 75) or Tapu Fini / Tapu Lele
Moon.instructions: 🏆 #1 TARGET: Necrozma (Lv. 75, Ten Carat Hill, catch rate 3 in SM) or Tapu Fini / Tapu Lele (Lv. 60). ⚠️ Do NOT use on Lunala (catch rate 45) or Ultra Beasts (use Beast Balls)!
Moon.prerequisites: Complete Ultra Beast Post-Game Missions

Ultra Sun.location: Ultra Warp Ride / Poni Grove — #1 Target: Ultra Wormhole Shiny/Box Legendaries or Blacephalon
Ultra Sun.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Ultra Warp Ride Legendaries (Mewtwo, Rayquaza, Giratina, Groudon, Ho-Oh) or Shiny Legendaries inside Ultra Space! (In USUM, Necrozma's catch rate was buffed to 255, so catch Necrozma in a standard Poké Ball!).
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Blacephalon at Poni Grove (knows Mind Blown which KO's itself in 2 turns!).
Ultra Sun.prerequisites: Unlock Ultra Warp Ride at Altar of the Sunne

pin.area: Altar of the Sunne / Poni Grove

Ultra Moon.location: Ultra Warp Ride / Ruins of Hope — #1 Target: Ultra Wormhole Shiny/Box Legendaries or Tapu Fini
Ultra Moon.instructions: 🏆 #1 TARGET: Ultra Warp Ride Legendaries (Mewtwo, Rayquaza, Lugia, Kyogre, Zekrom, Palkia) or Tapu Fini (Aqua Ring). (Necrozma has catch rate 255 in USUM, so don't use your Master Ball on Necrozma!).
Ultra Moon.prerequisites: Unlock Ultra Warp Ride at Altar of the Moone

pin.area: Altar of the Moone / Poni Island

Let's Go Pikachu.location: Cerulean Cave B1F — #1 Target: Mewtwo (Lv. 70) or Fleeing Shiny / Wild Legendary Bird
Let's Go Pikachu.instructions: 🏆 #1 TARGET: Mewtwo (Lv. 70, Cerulean Cave B1F) or any Wild Shiny / Roaming Legendary Bird before it flees! Bonus: Additional Master Balls respawn on the glowing floor tiles of Cerulean Cave 2F.
Let's Go Pikachu.prerequisites: Enter Hall of Fame

Let's Go Eevee.location: Cerulean Cave B1F — #1 Target: Mewtwo (Lv. 70) or Fleeing Shiny / Wild Legendary Bird
Let's Go Eevee.instructions: 🏆 #1 TARGET: Mewtwo (Lv. 70, Cerulean Cave B1F) or any Wild Shiny / Roaming Legendary Bird!
Let's Go Eevee.prerequisites: Enter Hall of Fame

Sword.location: Crown Shrine / Energy Plant — #1 Target: Calyrex (Lv. 80), Galarian Birds, or Shiny G-Max
Sword.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Calyrex (Lv. 80 at Crown Shrine, catch rate 3, long cutscene before battle) and Galarian Articuno/Zapdos/Moltres (with your 2nd Master Ball from Peony). ⚠️ Do NOT use on Eternatus or Max Lair Dynamax Adventure Legendaries—both have a 100% guaranteed catch rate in any Poké Ball!
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Non-event Shiny Gigantamax Raid Bosses or Zacian (Lv. 70).
Sword.prerequisites: Post-Game / Crown Tundra DLC

Shield.location: Crown Shrine / Energy Plant — #1 Target: Calyrex (Lv. 80), Galarian Birds, or Shiny G-Max
Shield.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Calyrex (Lv. 80 at Crown Shrine) and Galarian Birds (catch rate 3). ⚠️ Never waste a Master Ball on Eternatus or Max Lair bosses (100% catch rate)!
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Shiny Gigantamax Raid Bosses or Zamazenta (Lv. 70).
Shield.prerequisites: Post-Game / Crown Tundra DLC

Brilliant Diamond.location: Spear Pillar / Sinnoh Routes — #1 Target: Roaming Mesprit/Cresselia or Hall of Origin Arceus (Lv. 80)
Brilliant Diamond.instructions:
🏆 #1 TARGET: Roaming Mesprit/Cresselia (Lv. 50) OR Hall of Origin Arceus (Lv. 80, knows Healing Wish which causes self-KO if it runs out of attacking PP!).
🥈 RUNNER-UP: Ramanas Park Legendaries (Mewtwo, Rayquaza, Giratina).
Brilliant Diamond.prerequisites: National Pokédex / Azure Flute

Shining Pearl.location: Spear Pillar / Sinnoh Routes — #1 Target: Roaming Mesprit/Cresselia or Hall of Origin Arceus (Lv. 80)
Shining Pearl.instructions:

nest_ball.name: Nest Ball (Up to 4.0x Low-Level Wild Catch Rate)
nest_ball.description: Grants up to a 4.0x catch rate multiplier on lower-level wild Pokémon (Levels 1–29), scaling higher the lower the target's level.
nest_ball.generalLocation: Verdanturf Town (Hoenn), Eterna City (Sinnoh), Violet/Goldenrod (HGSS), Striaton (Unova), Santalune/Lumiose (Kalos), Paniola (Alola), Motostoke (Galar), All Marts (Paldea)
nest_ball.generalInstructions: Formula (Gen 5+): Multiplier = ((41 - TargetLevel) / 10), capped at 4.0x for Lv. 1–10, 3.0x at Lv. 11, 2.0x at Lv. 21, and 1.0x at Lv. 30+. Perfect when backtracking to early routes for Pokédex completion without risking a knock-out!

heavy_ball.name: Heavy Ball (+20 to +30 Flat Bonus on Heavyweight Pokémon)
heavy_ball.description: A Kurt Apricorn Poké Ball crafted from a Black Apricorn. Instead of multiplying, it adds +20 to +30 directly to the target's base catch rate if the Pokémon weighs over 200–300 kg!
heavy_ball.generalLocation: Kurt's House in Azalea Town (Johto), Mount Hokulani (Alola), Ball Guy / Cram-o-matic (Galar), Porto Marinada Auctions (Paldea), Jubilife Craftworks (Hisui)
heavy_ball.generalInstructions: Because Heavy Ball ADDS +20 or +30 directly to a Pokémon's base catch rate (3) BEFORE status multipliers, it turns a base-3 Legendary weighing ≥ 300 kg (Lugia, Ho-Oh, Groudon, Kyogre, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Reshiram, Zekrom, Kyurem, Solgaleo, Celesteela, Guzzlord, Eternatus, Glastrier, Ting-Lu, Koraidon, Iron Hands, Metagross, Snorlax) from catch rate 3 into catch rate 23–33 (up to 11x effective boost)! ⚠️ Never throw at Pokémon under 100 kg (-20 penalty). In Legends: Arceus, Heavy/Leaden/Gigaton Balls are short-range stealth balls that get a massive back-strike multiplier on unsuspecting Pokémon.
heavy_ball.generalPrerequisites: Black Apricorn (Johto/Galar) or Porto Marinada Auction (Paldea)

love_ball.name: Love Ball (8.0x Same-Species Opposite-Gender Catch Rate)
love_ball.description: A Kurt Apricorn Poké Ball crafted from a Pink Apricorn. Provides an enormous 8.0x catch rate multiplier if your active Pokémon is the exact same species and opposite gender of the wild target!
love_ball.generalLocation: Kurt's House in Azalea Town (Johto), Malie Library (Alola), Ballonlea Ball Guy / Cram-o-matic (Galar), Porto Marinada Auctions (Paldea)
love_ball.generalInstructions: At 8.0x catch rate, Love Ball ties for the highest conditional multiplier of any non-Master Ball! (Fun fact: In original Gold/Silver, a bug made Love Ball give 8.0x when your Pokémon was the SAME species and SAME gender).

friend_ball.name: Friend Ball (Instant 150–200 Friendship on Capture)
friend_ball.description: A Kurt Apricorn Poké Ball crafted from a Green Apricorn (1.0x catch rate) that immediately sets the captured Pokémon's Friendship to 200 (150 in Gen 8–9) — just 10 points shy of the friendship-evolution threshold!
friend_ball.generalLocation: Kurt's House in Azalea Town (Johto), Malie City (Alola), Turffield Ball Guy / Cram-o-matic (Galar), Porto Marinada Auctions (Paldea)
friend_ball.generalInstructions: In Gen 8–9, Friendship evolutions require 160 Friendship. Catching Eevee, Riolu, Golbat, Chansey, Pichu, Cleffa, Togepi, Munchlax, Budew, or Snom in a Friend Ball means it evolves after just 1–2 levels or a single picnic wash!
friend_ball.generalPrerequisites: Green Apricorn (Johto/Galar) or Porto Marinada Auction (Paldea)

dream_ball.name: Dream Ball (4.0x Sleeping Pokémon Catch Rate & Entralink Ball)
dream_ball.description: Originally a 100% guaranteed capture ball in Unova's Entree Forest (Gen 5), redesigned in Gen 8–9 into an elite 4.0x catch-rate Poké Ball whenever the target Pokémon is Asleep (or holds Comatose)!
dream_ball.generalLocation: Entralink / Entree Forest (Unova), Wyndon Ball Guy / Max Raids (Galar), Porto Marinada Auctions & Pokédex Rewards (Paldea)
dream_ball.generalInstructions: Put the wild Pokémon or Legendary to sleep using Spore (Breloom / Amoonguss / Toedscruel), Yawn, or Hypnosis, then throw a Dream Ball! Its 4.0x multiplier stacks with the 2.5x Sleep status multiplier for an astonishing 10.0x total capture power!

beast_ball.name: Beast Ball (5.0x Ultra Beast Catch Rate / 0.1x Prestige Challenge Ball)
beast_ball.description: An Aether Foundation Ultra Wormhole Poké Ball engineered specifically for Ultra Beasts: grants a 5.0x catch rate multiplier on Nihilego, Buzzwole, Pheromosa, Xurkitree, Celesteela, Kartana, Guzzlord, Poipole, Stakataka, and Blacephalon, but suffers a 0.1x penalty on all non-Ultra Beasts!
beast_ball.generalLocation: Aether Paradise & Looker Motels (Alola), Stow-on-Side Market & Max Lair (Galar), Academy Pokédex Completion Reward (Paldea)
beast_ball.generalInstructions: In Sun/Moon/USUM, always use Beast Balls on Ultra Beasts (where regular balls suffer a 0.1x penalty). In Sword/Shield and Scarlet/Violet, catching a normal Legendary or 7-Star Mightiest Mark Raid Boss in a Beast Ball (0.1x wild catch rate, 100% on Tera/Max Raids!) is the ultimate flex!
